snapshot_envelope.payload_hash: sha256 of exact HTTP response bytes
snapshot_envelope.raw_payload_storage: base64 of exact HTTP response bytes, verified against payload_hash and parsed JSON
snapshot_envelope.snapshot_hash: sha256 of canonical envelope before snapshot_sha256 and vintage_id

options.qualification_use: current surface schema, liquidity coverage, publication timestamp and immutable lineage only
options.replication_limitation: Public current summaries are not a historical point-in-time surface; 2020-2022 remains blocked until an immutable archived surface is sourced.

basis.qualification_use: current/next contract mapping, price/basis schema, expiry lineage and immutable snapshot only
basis.replication_limitation: The public basis endpoint exposes only the latest 30 days; 2020-2022 remains blocked until official archives or an immutable licensed archive are sourced.

stablecoin.qualification_use: July 2026 metric coverage, status/publication metadata when supplied, and immutable daily snapshots only
stablecoin.replication_limitation: A current API history may be revised; 2020-2022 is ineligible unless the provider supplies point-in-time vintages or archived responses prove what was available then.

qualification_findings.finding: Current option summaries can include same-day deep-out-of-the-money contracts with mark_price equal to zero.
qualification_findings.handling: Preserve the row and count it as zero_mark_count, but exclude it from two_sided_positive_mark_count. No strategy sign, threshold, or PnL rule changed.

qualification_findings.finding: The current exchangeInfo response names the trading-state field contractStatus rather than status.
qualification_findings.handling: Validate contractStatus=TRADING. Endpoint, pair, contract types, factor rule, and dates are unchanged.

qualification_findings.finding: TxTfrValUSD at 1d for USDT is not available with community credentials; the endpoint returns HTTP 403.
qualification_findings.handling: Keep the transfer-volume factor contract unchanged and mark stablecoin qualification blocked pending licensed point-in-time data. Do not substitute transaction count or active-address metrics after pre-registration.

qualification_findings.finding: The first two successful qualification drafts hashed exact HTTP bytes but retained only parsed JSON, so the payload hashes could not be recomputed offline.
qualification_findings.handling: Exclude those drafts from eligible lineage. Store exact bytes as base64, verify raw hash, parsed equality, audit summary, envelope hash, vintage id, and filename before accepting replacement snapshots.
